keep_apart.why: USER ruling 2026-09-06: Canyon Slough produces BOTH of the deck's key colours (B for Unearth, R for Drannith Stinger), so it must not share the R-only cycler bucket. Discovery had merged it there at <=0.01.
Same ruling as the Sheltered Thicket pair: the dual-relevant-colour land stays out of the R-only bucket.

merge.why: USER ruling 2026-09-06: W-cyclers are identical for this deck's keep decision -- all Cycling {2} (free under Fluctuator), all enter tapped, all give W for Enlightened Tutor / Forsake the Worldly; the U/G side colours cast nothing in this list. Discovery split them on distances in the 0.01-0.06 coin-flip band (integer win turns: a handful of probes moved via tap-order perturbation), the same failure mode as the recorded FiveColour fetchland case.

USER ruling 2026-09-06: B-cyclers -- B for Unearth is the only relevant colour; the G/U sides cast nothing here. Discovery merged Festering Thicket + Fetid Pools on its own and left Polluted Mire out on a coin-flip-band distance.
